lede: Robert Kraft is the name the feeds keep landing on today, surfacing on Google Trends, Wikipedia and Lemmy inside the same window. A viral Fesshole confession made a quieter crossover run between Bluesky and Mastodon, and Marvel's Wolverine drew a parallel bump on YouTube and Wikipedia. On the builder side, alibaba/open-code-review topped GitHub Trending while Clipto MCP led the day's Product Hunt launches. Twelve of seventeen sources came back live.
